Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The equipment shall be a professional surgical clipper specifically designed for pre-operative hair r emoval and not a conventional hair/grooming trimmer. 2. It shall be suitable for surgical and trauma procedures, including clipping of hair from sensitive body areas. 3. The cutting system shall have a skin-protective blade design with the cutting edge positioned a way from the skin, minimising the risk of nicks, cuts and skin injury. 4. The clipper shall effectively remove thick/thin and coarse/fine hair in both wet and dry condition s. 5. It shall preferably incorporate a single universal surgical blade suitable for different body areas, thereby avoiding multiple blade types. 6. The clipper shall provide cordless operation on charging and shall be suitable for repeated insti tutional/OT use. 7. It shall have a rechargeable battery, preferably Lithium-ion, with charging-status indication and overcharge protection. 8. The blade shall have a quick-release/one-handed attachment and removal mechanism to facilit ate rapid blade change and cleaning. 9. The complete system shall include a dedicated charging stand/charger and compatible surgical blades, with replacement blades available from the OEM/authorised supplier. 10. The equipment shall have a minimum 2-year warranty, manufacturer/authorised service suppo rt in India, and shall be supported by appropriate user and cleaning/disinfection instructions. reduc e-nicks-raise-standards.pdf Note- Addl items rquired along with trimmer Surgical clipper Handle- Qty-01 Single use blade Assembly for Clipper 50 EA/CA- Qty-50 .
